stack_contract.qualification: Runtime stack/domain guards and compiler overflow checks; per-routine metadata is not a whole-task static stack bound.

limits: Four simultaneous user contexts including the root; separate private idle context.
Static reserved bank-zero stacks/direct pages and at most 16 registered zero-argument procedure entries.
Stored priority is ignored by FIFO scheduling; signals and Wait are deferred.
tc_MemEntry must remain empty; heap services and automatic resource reclamation remain pending.
Pinned AltirraOS PAL profiles; this is not arbitrary hardware, DOS, OS-service or DLI qualification.
